problem:
If
    $T=[\begin{aligned}-5\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $T.$

  

| ${T}^{T}=$ |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{T}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-5\end{aligned}]
$$
